title.narrative: Mine Action in Support of UNMISS in South Sudan

description.narrative: UNOPS support for UNMAS and UN Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS), has as its primary goal addressing explosive ordnance (EO) contamination, facilitating a safer environment for communities and aiding in the peace process. Key objectives include: clearing land for humanitarian access and resettlement, providing risk education to civilians, supporting UNMISS operations, and bolstering the National Mine Action Authority's capacity.
